d:
The winds o' Azeroth greet ye, and soon ye'll stand among some o' our mightiest kin. I'm proud to see how far ye've come--your future looks bright indeed.
The element o' air's a tricky one to master, but I've faith your skill will see ye through any challenge.
Make your way north into Arathi Highlands. In its northern hills, you'll find Veyric Thundervein. He'll teach ye more.

Many adventurers prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.
Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as an adventurer.
p: You will learn, friend, and one day you will be a great adventurer.
c: Excellent, friend! You are quite a fast learner.

d:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.
Go with the winds, young adventurer.
c:
A fledgling adventurer, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
Remember, friend, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
